title: Matter research workstream coordinator intake contract

matter_brief.description: Question, intended audience/use, jurisdiction, product/entity scope and date boundary.

authorized_source_manifest.description: Matter-scoped document and source identities, permissions and available versions.

items.description: Source/record descriptor; resolve its identity, access and content via a host-validated adapter.

capability_registry.description: Host-verified agent/tool bindings, enabled models and access limits; no inferred dispatch capability.

run_policy.description: Concurrency limits, retrieval/cost budget, cancellation, review requirements and allowed output actions.

$comment: The host must validate nested source descriptors against its actual DTOs. This specification deliberately does not fabricate production API shapes.
